email.subject1: a signal play for Local Express
email.body1:
Garen, saw Local Express partnered with LOC Software to deliver unified commerce for grocers.

New partnerships open more grocery accounts to chase than a lean SDR team can follow up on fast, and slow follow-up is where replies die. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so follow-up volume scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Garen, quick follow-up for Local Express.

Leading SDRs, the bottleneck is usually follow-up speed and volume: too many accounts, not enough hours in the day, and ramp time on every new rep eats into coverage right when you need it most.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three specific things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Garen, last bit of proof for Local Express.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Local Express's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Garen, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up and ramp without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up new partnerships is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I'll tailor it to Local Express either way.
